caseName: Nashville, Chattanooga & St. Louis Ry. Co. v. Webster
caseNameFull: Nashville, Chattanooga & St. Louis Ry. Co. v. Webster, Commissioner of Highways

opinions.text: This case is restored to the docket and assigned for reargument on Wednesday, January 16, 1935. It is ordered that Herbert S. Walters, successor in office of Prank W. Webster, be and he is hereby substituted as a party appellee in this cause.
